UnusedMediaSettings.description: Configuration for Limbo Umbraco Unused Media.

IgnoredFolderIds.description: The IDs of media folders that should be ignored when scanning for unused media. Media items located within any of these folders are excluded.

UnusedMediaDashboardSettings.description: Configuration for the unused media dashboard and access to its Management API endpoints.

AllowedGroups.description: The aliases of the user groups allowed to access the unused media dashboard and related Management API endpoints. If empty, all users with access to the content section are allowed.

Element.description: The URL of the dashboard element. If omitted, the package default element is used.

PerPage.description: The number of media items shown on each page.

PathName.description: The path name of the dashboard.
